Selected Features of a Penalised Model

Source: R/visualizations.R
selected_features.Rd

Returns the features retained by a model that performs built-in feature selection (e.g. the non-zero-coefficient predictors of "cox_lasso", "cox_adaptive_lasso", "cox_elastic_net"), read from metadata(mae)$analysis[[model]][[modality]][[split]]$selected_features. The returned features can be passed to plot_umap. For models without built-in selection ("blockForest", "flexynesis"), use top_features instead.

Usage

selected_features(mae, model, modality = NULL, split = "auto", rho = NULL)

Arguments

mae

A MultiAssayExperiment whose metadata()$analysis holds the fitted model.

model

Character string naming the model (e.g. "cox_lasso").

modality

Character string naming the omics modality (e.g. an "early_<omics>" tag, "mRNA", "meth"). Leave NULL for models stored without a modality level (joint methods), or to auto-resolve a model that has a single per-modality entry.

split

Which split to read: "auto" (default; the single split present besides "metrics", i.e. "train" in a training MAE) or an explicit "train" / "test".

rho

Numeric. For model = "AFTCoop" only: selects the beta_rho_<rho> feature set (e.g. rho = 0.5). If NULL (default) and only one rho was trained, it is resolved automatically.

Value

A character vector of selected feature names.

See also

top_features, plot_umap
